responsibility: This header defines the `neoversen1_tunings` model for Arm Neoverse N1 in the AArch64 backend. It combines Cortex-A76 extra costs with generic Armv8-A address costs, generic register-move costs, Cortex-A57-style vector costs, and Neoverse-specific issue-rate, alignment, prefetch, and tune-flag settings, providing the named cost profile that GCC uses for instruction selection and scheduling when tuning for Neoverse N1.
